result.finding: No Dockerfile is present in this repository, so an actual image size cannot be measured. Based on the application stack (Spring Boot 3.4.1 fat JAR on Java 17), a typical container image would be estimated at 300-450MB: a standard eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine or similar JRE base (~180MB) plus the Spring Boot fat JAR (typically 80-150MB for a service with this many dependencies) plus layer overhead.
evidence: No Dockerfile found in repository; Dockerfile resides in external parent docker directory
Spring Boot 3.4.1 fat JAR with Spring Cloud, Azure JDBC, Micrometer, and Chaos Monkey dependencies typically produces an 80-150MB artifact
Java 17 JRE base images (eclipse-temurin:17-jre-alpine) are approximately 180MB
values: Spring Boot fat JAR application layer: ~80-150MB
